title: Verify a settings change applies to future completions only and not to already-completed work orders
permissions_required: Admin / owner (settings area) + Work Order edit access.
preconditions: 1. Signed in as Admin.
2. A work order was already completed under the previous settings.
3. You can change a Work Order setting.
steps: 1. Complete a work order under the current Work Order settings so it reaches Complete.
2. Go to the Work Orders settings tab, change a relevant setting (e.g. turn Require Vendor Invoice Number ON and Require Review Before Completion ON) and Save.
3. Reopen the already-completed work order and inspect its status and whether any new gate now applies to it.
expected: 1. The already-completed work order still shows Complete and is not reverted or re-gated by the new settings.
2. No new invoice-number requirement or review step is applied retroactively to the completed work order.
3. Only work orders completed after the change follow the new settings (future completions only).

Completed WO S2-15844 (4448308d, labor-only, invoice $130.48) under invoice-OFF/review-OFF settings; then flipped Require Vendor Invoice Number ON + Require Review Before Completion ON and saved. Reopened WO still shows 'S2-15844 Complete' with no retroactive invoice-number prompt and no revert to Review — settings apply to future completions only, confirming non-retroactive behavior.

title: Verify special-order cores leave the optional-invoice completion unchanged and Complete Without Receiving stays available
preconditions: 1. Signed in as Admin.

3. Confirm Complete Without Receiving is still available.
expected: 1. There is nothing to resolve yet for special-order cores in the completion modal.
2. Complete Without Receiving remains available.
design_ref: Resolve Cores Flow - Handoff.md; requirements S3-C2
notes: Blocked-Env (precise, reconfirmed live 2026-07-14): a SPECIAL-ORDER (vendor-sourced) core cannot be created in this build. The genuine cored catalog part P550848 (core_charge=1, catalogue_part_id 4b4753e0) carries its core attribute ONLY when added via the inventory-source catalog path (select_part forces Source=Inventory). A vendor-sourced part request for the SAME part (POST /api/work-orders/part/make-request with part_source_type='vendor' + inventory_part_id of P550848) returns 201 but the resulting part request has is_core=false and core_charge=0 — the core charge is dropped. Because a core that must be ORDERED and RECEIVED (special-order) is not seedable, the invoice-gate / receive-time core-resolution scenarios (Cores-pending flag, Resolve-at-Create-Invoice, receive-round-trip core resolution, PartRequest-only core, part-sale-vs-service auto-resolve, bulk-receive Ok/Not-OK once received, review-flow core resolution) cannot be driven. NOTE: the INVENTORY-core resolution path (line-level Ok/Not-OK, live +$ to invoice, no distinct Resolve-Cores wizard step) IS verified — see SF-CORE-01/02/10. Needs a hand-seeded special-order/vendor core part (dev/data).

steps: 1. Read the modal header.
2. Read the per-line card (line #, name, technician).
3. Read the 'Line X of N' indicator.
4. Leave the textarea empty and check the Next/Continue button.
expected: 1. The header reads 'Tech story' with 'WO# · Customer'.
2. A per-line card shows the line number, name and technician; a 'Line X of N' indicator is shown.
3. The Next/Continue button is disabled until the textarea is non-empty.
notes: Wording+VIU 2026-07-13: tech-story inline sub-row 'Story' + 'Add tech story for this line' confirmed live on WO lines this run; tech-story modal header 'Tech story' with 'WO# · Customer', per-line card + 'Line X of N', Next disabled until textarea non-empty - verified prior VIU.

title: Verify multi-line tech-story navigation (Back after line 1, Continue/Save on the last line)
preconditions: 1. Signed in as Admin.
2. A work order has two or more lines all missing stories, and Require Tech Story is ON.
steps: 1. Start completion so the tech-story modal opens on Line 1 of N.
2. Enter a story and click Next.
3. On line 2, check for a Back button.
4. On the last line, check the final button.
expected: 1. On line 1 there is no Back button; after line 1, a Back button appears.
2. Each line requires a non-empty story to advance.
3. The last line shows Continue (chained into completion) or Save.
notes: Wording+VIU 2026-07-13: tech-story inline sub-row 'Story' + 'Add tech story for this line' confirmed live on WO lines this run; multi-line navigation (no Back on line 1; Back after; Continue/Save on last) - verified prior VIU.

title: Verify a saved tech story renders inline with a green check, the text and an Edit link
preconditions: 1. Signed in as Admin.
2. A line has a saved tech story.
steps: 1. View the line's Story sub-row.
2. Confirm the story text and controls.
expected: 1. The saved story renders inline with a green check and the story text.
2. An Edit link is available to change it.
notes: Wording+VIU 2026-07-13: tech-story inline sub-row 'Story' + 'Add tech story for this line' confirmed live on WO lines this run; saved story renders inline with a green check + text + Edit link - verified prior VIU.

title: Verify the tech-story modal has a text box for typing the story
preconditions: 1. Signed in as Admin.
2. The tech-story modal is open.
steps: 1. Open the tech-story modal on a line.
2. Locate the text box where the story is typed.
3. Type a story into the text box.
expected: 1. The tech-story modal has a text box (textarea) for the story.
2. The story text you type is accepted in the box.

Textarea confirmed present.

title: Verify tech story is captured both inline and via the gate modal (Story 17 supersedes on-the-line-only wording)
preconditions: 1. Signed in as Admin.
2. A work order has a line missing a story.
steps: 1. Add a tech story inline via the line's 'Add tech story' link.
2. On a separate line missing a story, trigger the gate modal by clicking Complete.
3. Confirm both entry points save a story.
expected: 1. A tech story can be entered inline on the line (Story 17 is the authoritative behavior).
2. A story can also be entered via the completion gate modal, which lets stories be completed individually or several at once.
3. Both paths persist the story.
design_ref: WO Review Flow.html; requirements TS Decision / S15-R2
notes: Wording+VIU 2026-07-13: tech-story inline sub-row 'Story' + 'Add tech story for this line' confirmed live on WO lines this run; tech story captured both inline on the line and via the completion gate modal (individually or several at once); both persist (Story 17 authoritative) - verified prior VIU.
